title: Hepta HIA explicit systems dialect v1
description: Structured LLVM20-bound systems semantics. Unsafe memory, native assembly and ABI details are explicit. This is separate from HIA safe Core v1-v8.

instruction.description: Operation-specific required/forbidden fields and semantics are enforced by system_instructions.cpp; each result is constructed anew and LLVM verification is mandatory.

use_order.description: Exact ordered references to the users and operand slots of this basic block. The decoder validates a bijection over all fresh LLVM uses and writes bitcode preserving the resulting order.
